content: {"praised":["Strong acting by Layke Anderson and supporting cast.","Impressive cinematography and visual style reminiscent of 1920s Berlin.","Engaging music featuring Roy Orbison and drag performances.","Heartwarming love story between Frank and Jake.","Intense portrayal of life and death during 1980s AIDS crisis."],"criticized":["Story feels unbelievable and farcical.","Pacing slow and boring.","Tone too preachy and annoying.","Excessive kissing scenes disrespectful to AIDS reality.","Characters lack depth and realism."]}
